record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: There is a theory of free Banach lattices, [ 15 ]. Is there a sensible notion of a free Banach lattice algebra? If so, what can be said about its representations?

evidence.quote: There is a theory of free Banach lattices, [ 15 ]. Is there a sensible notion of a free Banach lattice algebra? If so, what can be said about its representations?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Banach lattice algebra is a real Banach space $A$ that is simultaneously a Banach lattice (i.e., $A$ is a vector lattice and the norm satisfies $|x|\le|y|\Rightarrow\|x\|\le\|y\|$) and a Banach algebra (i.e., $A$ carries an associative multiplication with $\|xy\|\le\|x\|\,\|y\|$), and in which the product of two positive elements is positive (i.e., $x,y\ge 0$ implies $xy\ge 0$).

Recall that for every Banach space $E$ there exists a free Banach lattice $\mathrm{FBL}[E]$ generated by $E$: a Banach lattice together with an isometric embedding $\eta_E:E\to\mathrm{FBL}[E]$ such that, for every Banach lattice $X$ and every bounded linear operator $T:E\to X$, there is a unique lattice homomorphism $\widehat T:\mathrm{FBL}[E]\to X$ with $\widehat T\circ\eta_E=T$ and $\|\widehat T\|=\|T\|$.

Question. Is there an analogous useful notion of a free Banach lattice algebra generated by a Banach space $E$? Concretely, does there exist a Banach lattice algebra $\mathrm{FBLA}[E]$ together with an isometric embedding $\eta_E:E\to\mathrm{FBLA}[E]$ that is universal in the following sense: for every Banach lattice algebra $A$ and every bounded linear operator $T:E\to A$, there is a unique Banach-lattice-algebra homomorphism $\widehat T:\mathrm{FBLA}[E]\to A$ with $\widehat T\circ\eta_E=T$ and $\|\widehat T\|=\|T\|$? If such an object exists, describe its structure and its representations (i.e., its continuous Banach-lattice-algebra homomorphisms into concrete Banach lattice algebras of operators or of functions).
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has introduced and studied free Banach f-algebras generated by a Banach space (Muñoz-Lahoz and Tradacete), giving a universal Banach f-algebra FBFA[E] with the appropriate universal property. This addresses the question in the commutative (f-algebra) setting, indicating partial progress on the original question of a "sensible notion" of a free Banach lattice algebra and its representations, while the general non-commutative Banach lattice algebra case remains less developed.

status_evidence.title: Free Banach f-algebras — D. Muñoz-Lahoz (joint with P. Tradacete)
status_evidence.snippet: The free Banach f-algebra generated by E is a Banach f-algebra FBFA[E] together with an isometric embedding ηE : E → FBFA[E] such that, for every Banach f-algebra X and every operator T : E → X, there exists a unique lattice homomorphism T̂ : FBFA[E] → X with ∥T̂∥ = ∥T∥.
status_evidence.claim: A universal free Banach f-algebra generated by a Banach space has been constructed, providing a partial positive answer in the commutative lattice-ordered setting.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice algebras: some questions, but very few answers
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on Banach lattice algebras noting many open questions.
status_evidence.claim: The general theory of Banach lattice algebras still contains many unresolved foundational questions.
